title: Claude Code — AI-Powered Agentic Coding Tool
excerpt: Claude Code brings AI intelligence into your terminal, IDE, and GitHub workflows. 13 official plugins, 15+ workflows, multi-language. Plugin system with commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP servers.

title: Plugins — Extensible Plugin Ecosystem
excerpt: 13 official plugins providing commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP server integrations. Plugin architecture with manifest auto-discovery, slash commands, specialized agents, progressive-disclosure skills, and event-driven hooks.

title: Plugin Dev — Plugin Development Toolkit
excerpt: Comprehensive toolkit for developing Claude Code plugins with 7 specialized skills, 3 expert agents, and an 8-phase guided creation workflow. Skills cover plugin structure, agents, commands, hooks, MCP, settings, and skill development.

title: PR Review Toolkit — Multi-Agent PR Analysis
excerpt: 6 specialized review agents for PR analysis: comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer, code-reviewer, code-simplifier. Confidence scoring with threshold of 80.

title: Hookify — Python Rule Engine for Custom Hooks
excerpt: Python-based plugin enabling custom event-driven hooks with markdown rules and YAML frontmatter. Rule engine with 6 operators: regex_match, contains, equals, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with. Supports PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, UserPromptSubmit events.

title: Feature Dev — 7-Phase Feature Development
excerpt: Structured workflow with parallel code exploration, architecture design, and quality review. 3 specialized agents: code-explorer, code-architect, code-reviewer. 7 phases from discovery to summary.

title: Agent SDK Dev — SDK Scaffolding & Verification
excerpt: Development kit for creating Claude Agent SDK applications in Python and TypeScript. Interactive guided setup with /new-sdk-app command. Automated verification against best practices.

title: Ralph Wiggum — Autonomous AI Loop Runner
excerpt: Continuous self-referential AI loops. Claude works on the same task repeatedly, reading its own previous output. Uses Stop hook to intercept session exit and re-feed the prompt. Completion promises for loop termination.

title: Code Review — Multi-Agent Automated PR Review
excerpt: Automated PR code review with 4+ parallel agents. CLAUDE.md compliance checking, bug detection with Opus, historical context analysis. Confidence-based filtering at 80 threshold.

title: Commit Commands — Git Workflow Automation
excerpt: Style-aware commits, branch management, and PR creation. Three commands: /commit, /commit-push-pr, /clean_gone. Analyzes recent commit history for message style.

title: Claude Opus 4.5 Migration — Model Migration Tool
excerpt: Automated migration from Claude 4.x to Opus 4.5 across Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure. Model string replacement, beta header cleanup, prompt adjustments.

title: Frontend Design — Bold UI Design Guidance
excerpt: Creates distinctive production-grade frontend interfaces avoiding generic AI aesthetics. Bold design choices for typography, color, animation, spatial composition. 10+ aesthetic directions.

title: Explanatory Output Style — Educational Insights Hook
excerpt: SessionStart hook that injects educational context about implementation choices and codebase patterns. Recreates the deprecated Explanatory output style as a plugin.

title: Learning Output Style — Interactive Learning Mode
excerpt: Combines explanatory insights with interactive code participation. Requests meaningful code contributions from users at decision points. Two modes: Learning and Explanatory.

title: Security Guidance — Vulnerability Pattern Detection
excerpt: PreToolUse hook monitoring 9 security patterns: command injection, XSS, unsafe deserialization, eval, innerHTML, pickle, os.system. Session-scoped state prevents warning fatigue.

title: Scripts — GitHub Automation & Issue Management
excerpt: TypeScript and shell scripts for issue lifecycle management. Duplicate detection pipeline, stale issue sweeping, label management, restricted GitHub CLI wrapper. STALE_UPVOTE_THRESHOLD of 10.

title: GitHub Workflows — CI/CD & Automated Operations
excerpt: 15 GitHub Actions workflows for issue triage, duplicate management, lifecycle enforcement, and Claude Code mentions. Includes twice-daily sweep schedule and event-driven automation.

title: Examples — Configuration & Hook Examples
excerpt: Reference configurations for hooks and settings profiles. Three security profiles: lax, strict, bash-sandbox. Example PreToolUse hook for bash command validation.
